name: @fuzex/identity
description: Server-owned entity identifiers (TypeID: prefix + UUIDv7 base32) for FuzeX's own product-local entity types. Independent re-implementation of the same wire format as @izzywdev/fuzefront-identity (see README.md) — this repo keeps its OWN registry per governance/identifier-standard.md #2 ('each repo keeps its own registry, there is deliberately no central one').
